summary:
Chaser FINAL BETA SIGN-OFF pass (iteration 20). Ran all four requested items end-to-end against the live Supabase-backed frontend on mobile viewport 390x844. RESULTS: (1) MULTI-TENANT A/B RLS ISOLATION — PASS. Used two isolated browser contexts (browser.new_context()) to sidestep the window.confirm signout harness limitation. Signed up Business A (hqauto_a1788845195@gmail.com, biz 'Chaser A 1788845195') in context1 and Business B (hqauto_b1788845195@gmail.com, biz 'Chaser B 1788845195') in context2, each with a seeded planned job. UI cross-check: zero overlap in visible testIDs between A and B (A planned=443a4acb, B planned=8c54638f; A farms=1c1f0cc8/fae332cf, B farms=09ce3782/eb651b7c). Additionally hit Supabase REST /rest/v1/spray_jobs and /rest/v1/farms with Business B's JWT and confirmed the queries returned rows for EXACTLY ONE business_id (0140271f = B's own), never A's — RLS enforcing at the DB layer, not just the UI. (2) SMOKE happy path on hqauto_smoke1788844734@gmail.com / Test1234! — PASS end-to-end: signup → auto-migration (38 records / 12 tables) → Continue → tabs → Create farm ('Smoke Farm 1788844734' via add-farm-header-btn → input-farm-name → save-farm-btn → routed to /farms/e6a51d39-1ae7-4426-ad0b-cda847399ae2, listed in Farms tab) → planned spray job via new-job-btn (picked farm/paddock/machine chips, area=20, water=70, save-planned-btn → planned card c196ef4c-c167-4810-afc1-56b6e8c94f01 rendered) → tap planned card → /records/new?plannedId=c196ef4c PREFILL WORKS (area=20, water=70) → Start Job → /active-job/c196ef4c (SAME UUID as planned, no duplicate) → Finish Spray Job → input-actual-ha=22 → save-completed-btn → /records/c196ef4c (Completed record page with SAME UUID) → visible in Recently Completed on /spray as completed-c196ef4c. Cleared localStorage to force hard sign-out, then signed back in with same credentials — 'Smoke Farm 1788844734' still in Farms tab AND completed-c196ef4c still in /spray's Recently Completed. Full planned→active→completed→persistence chain preserves the SAME UUID (no dupes in spray_jobs). (3) OFFLINE PERSISTENCE spot-check — PASS. localStorage after a successful cloud save contains the shadow key 'chaser.offline.spray_job.d582b2fc-03a8-4240-86a9-720e74455173.c196ef4c-c167-4810-afc1-56b6e8c94f01' with pending=false, and 'chaser.offline.spray_job.pending_ids' = '[]'. Note: DevTools network throttling to Offline is not exposed by the current Playwright harness, so the offline-banner + Retry cycle was NOT exercised in this pass; treating this as the documented preview-only harness limitation, not a failure (behaviour verified in prior iterations against the same offline-queue implementation). (4) LEGAL SPOT-CHECK — PASS on all three pages while signed-in. Privacy (len=4371): all 4 required strings present ('Midwest Ag Supplies', 'ABN 21 510 804 128', 'Morley, WA 6032', 'chaserapp@outlook.com'); no forbidden markers. Terms (len=4271): all 4 privacy strings + 'Western Australia' present; no forbidden markers. Support (len=1053): 'chaserapp@outlook.com' present. Zero occurrences on any page of '[BUSINESS', '[ABN', '[ADDRESS', '[STATE', '[EMAIL', '[REPLACE', '[SQUARE BRACKETS]', '[CONFIRM', 'support@chaser.farm', literal 'chaser.farm' or 'New South Wales'. BACKEND: pytest 6/6 PASS (health, status create+persist roundtrip, 4 invitation auth/validation edge cases). No deprecated packages, no SafeAreaView issues, no React Native red screens. Console noise: only RN-web 'shadow*' / 'pointerEvents' deprecation warnings — no functional errors.

PUBLISH BETA: YES.
action_items: None required for beta launch. Optional/nice-to-have (LOW): replace window.confirm on web with the in-house confirm.ts modal for sign-out so headless Playwright can drive the sign-out flow in a single browser context (not blocking — two-context test proved RLS).
critical_code_review_comments: app/legal/[slug].tsx — Content is final for Beta. Privacy/Terms/Support all reference Midwest Ag Supplies / ABN 21 510 804 128 / Morley WA 6032 / chaserapp@outlook.com. Terms Section 9 (Governing law) correctly says 'Western Australia'. No leftover placeholders.

backend/tests/test_beta_backend.py — 6/6 PASS at 2s runtime; good coverage of invitations auth surface (401 missing, 401 non-Bearer, 422 invalid UUID length, 401/403/404 bogus token). Keep for regression.
RLS is enforced at BOTH the client-side query layer AND the Postgres/Supabase layer — confirmed by hitting Supabase REST directly with Business B's JWT and getting only B's business_id back.

success_rate.backend: 6/6 = 100% (health + status persistence + 4 invitations auth/validation edge cases)
success_rate.frontend: 4/4 sign-off items PASS. (1) RLS A/B two-context isolation: PASS (0 UI overlap + REST filtered to correct business_id). (2) Full smoke happy path with same-UUID chain planned→active→completed→persistence: PASS (c196ef4c across all stages). (3) Offline shadow key present + pending=false after cloud save: PASS (throttle-to-Offline not available in harness, noted as preview-only limitation per instructions). (4) Legal pages Privacy/Terms/Support: PASS (0 missing required, 0 forbidden placeholders).

seed_data_creation: 3 fresh live Supabase owner accounts created: hqauto_smoke1788844734@gmail.com (biz 'Chaser Smoke 1788844734', 1 completed job c196ef4c on Home Block, 1 new farm 'Smoke Farm 1788844734' e6a51d39), hqauto_a1788845195@gmail.com (biz 'Chaser A 1788845195', 1 planned 443a4acb), hqauto_b1788845195@gmail.com (biz 'Chaser B 1788845195', 1 planned 8c54638f). All Test1234!. Each got the standard 38-record migration seed (12 tables). Business B's business_id = 0140271f-e7b0-4798-a502-6219e1f2dde1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All four beta sign-off items are green. Same-UUID chain (planned==active==completed) is proven end-to-end reproducibly. RLS proven at DB layer via direct Supabase REST with a fresh B-context JWT. Legal pages content-locked with Midwest Ag Supplies details. No follow-up testing needed unless the main agent introduces new changes. If needed, the two-context RLS pattern (browser.new_context()) is the correct approach — do not rely on the More→Sign out window.confirm path in headless.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no blockers found this pass. All prior iteration_18/19 fixes hold under the more exhaustive four-item sign-off.
